entries.en: Hey man, where are you? Hellooo! Scorpion?
entries.ro: Hei, frate, unde ești? Hellooo! Scorpion?

entries.en: Mhm, perfect! Keep broadcasting over an open channel, just in case they missed you the first time! God, I swear!
entries.ro: Mhm, perfect! Ține-o tot așa, pe canal deschis, să nu rămână dubii că te-au auzit din prima! Doamne, jur!

entries.en: I see the wreck. But no Scorpion. Or Mitch.
entries.ro: Văd epava. Dar nici Scorpion, nici Mitch.

entries.en: V, connect to the drone. We'll scan the area. We have to get our bearings.
entries.ro: V, conectează-te la dronă. Scanăm zona. Trebuie să ne orientăm.

entries.en: Fucking corporate rats...
Got five Kangs on patrol.
I - I'm sorry. Your clan?
Mitch! He's alive! They have them!
[Connect] Let's go.
FUUUCK YYOU AAAAALLLL!
Aldecaldos. Yes. They're dead, all of them...
He's not reading me. Fucking interference!
entries.ro: Nu mă citește. Ce interferență de căcat!

entries.en: Answer, Mitch! Come on, answer!
Let's check it out.
Can't we take it down somehow?
Combat drones – defense systems active.
entries.ro: Drone de luptă – sisteme de apărare active.

entries.en: They secured the area. They're waiting for reinforcements. Shit...
entries.ro: Au securizat zona. Așteaptă întăriri. Căcat...

entries.en: Maybe... But we have to get there first.
entries.ro: Poate... Dar trebuie să ajungem noi primii.

entries.en: They've set up the launcher. They'll tear us to shreds if we get too close.
entries.ro: Au instalat lansatorul. Ne fac praf dacă ne apropiem prea mult.

entries.en: Oh, no, no, no…
They won't mark us?
They won't mark us?
I'll enable the masking. Their scanners are out. They're blind.
entries.ro: Activez mascarea. Scannerele lor sunt oprite. Sunt orbi.

entries.en: Something's not right. Did you hear those shots? V, something happened to them!
entries.ro: Ceva nu e în regulă. Ai auzit focurile alea? V, li s-a întâmplat ceva!

entries.en: [Disconnect]
This is our only way to check on Mitch and Scorpion.
entries.ro: Asta e singura noastră șansă să aflăm ce e cu Mitch și Scorpion.

entries.en: V, if they...
Don't worry. We don't know for sure...
entries.ro: Nu-ți face griji. Nu știm sigur...

entries.en: V, this does not look good...
Let's roll. You connecting to visual?
entries.ro: Hai să mergem. Te conectezi la vizual?

entries.en: V, if they got the Aldecaldos... If they got Mitch and Scorpion, I can't, I don't...
entries.ro: V, dacă i-au pe Aldecaldos... Dacă i-au pe Mitch și Scorpion, nu pot, nu...

entries.en: I know, I know...
Mhm...
Connected. I'm in control.
Looks expired.
Fuck it.
